headline: Banana Exporter Uniban Launches 600-Hectare Plantation in Colombia
summary: Colombian fruit exporter Uniban announced an initiative to plant 600 hectares of export bananas in the department of Córdoba, projecting eventual cultivation expansion across up to 4,000 hectares.
why: Uniban is one of Colombia's primary agricultural exporters, with banana shipments representing a major foreign exchange earner in the non-energy export basket.

impacts.name: Colombian Agriculture
impacts.why: Expanding commercial banana cultivation drives regional employment and agricultural export volume.
